sql: select o.market_ticker, o.side, o.action, o.limit_price, o.quantity, o.status, o.cancel_reason, o.created_at, (select p.quantity_fp from positions p where p.market_ticker=o.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) pos from live_orders o where o.strategy='Alimm1' and o.created_at > now() - interval '30 hours' and (o.market_ticker like '%NUCL%' or o.status not in ('resting','canceled','cancelled')) order by o.created_at
